# ZEECOM SOLUTION

> ZEECOM SOLUTION delivers turnkey intelligent enterprise physical security, VoIP integrated CRM contact centers, and IP-Audio mass notification systems.

## Overview
ZEECOM SOLUTION is an enterprise systems engineering and technology infrastructure provider headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, serving industrial, corporate, educational, healthcare, and hospitality facilities worldwide.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI-Powered Surveillance & Access Control**: 4K smart dome surveillance, automated behavioral anomaly detection, touchless biometric facial recognition, and unified multi-site access control.
- **VoIP Integrated CRM & Contact Center**: Cloud and on-premise PBX, click-to-dial, inbound caller dossiers, IVR automation, call recordings, and omnichannel CRM synchronizations.
- **IP-Audio & Public Address Systems**: Multi-zone IP network audio, SIP/ONVIF integrated intercoms, ambient background music, and instant one-touch emergency mass notification dispatch.

## Interactive Tools
- **AI Solutions Architect**: Dynamic architectural capacity estimator and BOM generator for security, VoIP, and IP audio.
- **Interactive System Configurator**: Live multi-zone security, telephony, and audio deployment designer with real-time budget forecasting.
